_comment: Every bare function name shared by more than one definition in src/spendguard, with the verdict a model reached by reading the BODIES (scripts/probe/review_axes.py name). PROTOCOL = intentional polymorphism, correct as-is. DUPLICATION = one job, many copies; merge. COLLISION = different jobs wearing one name; rename. This file is a BASELINE, not an approval: tests/test_names_stay_unique.py fails on any name NOT listed here, so new collisions must be judged before they land. Shrinking this file is the goal.
